title: Ballard Institute and Museum of Puppetry

services.name: Past Exhibits
services.desc: Becoming Modern: U.S. Puppetry in the Twentieth Century, curated by Ballard Institute Director John Bell, highlights a variety of artists that demonstrate the emergence of innovations based on the idea of puppetry as a modern performance form, including Basil Milovsoroff, Larry Reed, Sandy Spieler, Dan Hurlin, Janie Geiser, Peter Schumann, Theodora Skipitares, and more. This is a permanent exhibit from the Ballard Institute’s collection that includes puppets from all over the world to show the global scope of the artform. It moves geographically from right to left moving from Asia, to Europe, and ending with puppets from the US. Wednesday: 11am-5pm Thursday: 11am-7pm Friday: 11am-5pm
